manual.title: Enter the vent's MAC address
manual.description: No AirTap is advertising right now, so enter its Bluetooth MAC address.

no_devices.title: No AirTap found nearby
no_devices.description: Home Assistant doesn't hear any AirTap over Bluetooth right now. Wi-Fi AirTaps (Airtap AI) don't need Bluetooth, they can be added from your AC Infinity account.

menu_options.cloud_account: Sign in to AC Infinity (Wi-Fi AirTaps)
menu_options.manual: Enter a Bluetooth MAC address (Bluetooth AirTaps)

cloud_account.title: Sign in to AC Infinity
cloud_account.description: Sign in with the account your Wi-Fi AirTap is added to in the AC Infinity app.

cloud.title: Sign in to AC Infinity
cloud.description: This is a Wi-Fi AirTap (Airtap AI), which only takes commands through the AC Infinity cloud, not Bluetooth. Sign in with the account it's added to in the AC Infinity app.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the vent. The Home Assistant log has the details.
error.cloud_unreachable: Couldn't reach the AC Infinity cloud. The Home Assistant log has the details.
error.invalid_auth: AC Infinity didn't accept that email and password.
error.not_in_account: This vent isn't on that AC Infinity account. Add it in the AC Infinity app first. The Home Assistant log lists what the account has.
error.no_airtaps: That AC Infinity account has no Wi-Fi AirTaps left to add. Add the vent in the AC Infinity app first. The Home Assistant log lists what the account has.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This vent is already set up.
